name: Youchul Jeong
title: Ph.D. Candidate in Marine Science
about: Youchul Jeong is a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Marine Science at the University of the Aegean (Marine Remote Sensing Group - MRSG) and an External Ph.D. candidate with the Machine Learning in Earth Observation (MEO) Lab at the University of Bonn. His research aims to develop remote-sensing and machine-learning methods for detecting floating marine debris and other sea-surface features from satellite and UAV observations.

experience.description: Constructed floating plastic-litter targets using HDPE tarps and wooden planks in 1 m², 2 m², and 3 m² configurations for the PLP2025 field experiment. Assisted with field deployment, monitoring, repair, and retrieval of six target units in the Gulf of Gera, Lesvos.

experience.position: Classification and Monitoring of Floating Marine Macro Litter (MSc Thesis)
experience.description: Utilized drones with multispectral sensors to create a custom FMML dataset. Implemented deep learning models for efficient litter classification and continuous monitoring. Incorporated drone atmospheric correction using DROACOR in collaboration with Dr. Daniel Schläpfer (ReSe Application LLC). Worked with advisors to promote conceptual framework and fieldwork at international conferences.

experience.position: Floating Marine Debris and Physical Ocean Phenomena in S-ORS
experience.description: Applied drone technology and Applied Drone Automatic Flight Advisory in open ocean conditions. Developed a CNN model for detecting marine debris for Socheongcho Ocean Research Station.

experience.institution: Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology (KIOST)
experience.description: Worked with Dr. Won Joon Shim (KIOST) to conduct on-site surveys of microplastics and floating marine litter. Compared and analyzed results of drone and multispectral sensor surveys.
